Legend · Passive

Base skill
At the beginning of a battle and at the beginning of the owner's turn, grants 1 layer of [Stellar Bastion Shield] to all allies (increases Mastery and Mastery RES by 0.5%), up to 20 layers. Grants 1 layer of [Stellar Judgment Radiance] to the ally with the highest initial ATK (increases Crit DMG by 2%), up to 10 layers.

Full skill text at 5★
At the beginning of a battle and at the beginning of the owner's turn, grants 1 layer of [Stellar Bastion Shield] to all allies (increases Mastery and Mastery RES by 2%), up to 20 layers. Grants 1 layer of [Stellar Judgment Radiance] to the ally with the highest initial ATK (increases Crit DMG by 5%), up to 10 layers. When granting [Stellar Bastion Shield] or [Stellar Judgment Radiance] to allies with the [Loong's Wrath] tag, grants 1 additional layer. Each time a skill is cast, all allies deal 0.5% increased DMG to Bosses. For every 1 deployed ally with the [Direct DMG] tag, all allies deal an additional 0.1% increased DMG to Bosses, up to 10 layers.
Full skill text at 7★
At the beginning of a battle and at the beginning of the owner's turn, grants 1 layer of [Stellar Bastion Shield] to all allies (increases Mastery and Mastery RES by 2%), up to 20 layers. Grants 1 layer of [Stellar Judgment Radiance] to the ally with the highest initial ATK (increases Crit DMG by 5%), up to 10 layers. When granting [Stellar Bastion Shield] or [Stellar Judgment Radiance] to allies with the [Loong's Wrath] tag, grants 1 additional layer. Each time a skill is cast, all allies deal 0.5% increased DMG to Bosses. For every 1 deployed ally with the [Direct DMG] tag, all allies deal an additional 0.1% increased DMG to Bosses, up to 10 layers. Increases the owner's Direct DMG by 25%. If the owner has the [Loong's Wrath] tag, increases the owner's Skill DMG by 30% and reduces Skill DMG taken by 30%. When the owner has max layers of [Stellar Bastion Shield], the ally with the highest ATK deals 10% increased DMG to Bosses. For every 10 layers of [Stellar Bastion Shield] gained in total, the owner retains 1 HP until the beginning of their own turn upon taking Fatal DMG. At the beginning of self own turns, restores 100% of their Max HP; this effect can trigger up to 2 time(s).
Source: game files.

Effects

  • [Stellar Bastion Shield] — Increases Mastery and Mastery RES by a certain amount.
  • [Stellar Judgment Radiance] — Increases Crit DMG by a certain amount.
